info.name: Arcadia Finance API
info.description:
REST API for the Arcadia Finance demo banking application.

WARNING: Intentionally vulnerable (SQL injection, plain-text passwords, verbose errors) for F5 WAF/security demonstration purposes. NEVER deploy in production.

## Authentication

All private endpoints require a valid JWT Bearer token (HS256, 8-hour expiry).

Workflow:
1. POST /api/token with username + password -> receive access_token
2. Every request: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

The collection variable {{base_url}} defaults to http://localhost:8080. After running 'Get Token' or 'Login', the {{token}} variable is set automatically.

request.description:
INTENTIONALLY VULNERABLE TO BOLA (OWASP API1:2023).
Any valid token holder can enumerate all user profiles including plain-text passwords:
  GET /api/users/1 -> Alice + password
  GET /api/users/2 -> Thomas + password
  GET /api/users/3 -> Sophie + password
  GET /api/users/4 -> Lucas + password
